Description: Settings for the server can be configured in 'SCUM/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/ServerSettings.ini', or in-game by admins listed under Admin Users For Server Settings
Sets the public name of the server displayed in the in-game server browser
Sets the description text displayed for the server in the server browser
Password required for players to join the server. Leave blank for a public server
Sets the maximum number of players that may connect to the server at one time
Direct URL to a custom banner image displayed on the server info screen
Message displayed to players when they connect to the server
Recurring announcement message broadcast in server chat
DefaultValue: This is the Message of the Day.
Placeholder: This is the Message of the Day.

Description: Cooldown interval in seconds between Message of the Day broadcasts
Automatically disconnects players whose latency exceeds the Maximum Ping limit
Maximum allowed player ping in milliseconds before being kicked
Automatically deletes character data for players who have not logged in for the configured number of days
Number of days since last login before an inactive user's character is deleted
Performs a partial wipe (resets world items, bases, and vehicles while keeping character skills/fame) on next server startup
Wipes all player gold balances on next server startup
Performs a complete database wipe (characters, bases, vehicles, economy) on next server startup. Use with caution
List of [Steam64 IDs](https://steamid.io/) of players who are allowed to join the server. If any IDs are set, only those players will be able to connect, turning the server into a 'whitelist' server

List of [Steam64 IDs](https://steamid.io/) of players who are allowed to join the server even if it is otherwise full. Commonly used as a VIP list. If the server is full, a random player will be kicked from the server to allow a reserved player to join

List of [Steam64 IDs](https://steamid.io/) for users who will be allowed to use admin commands in-game and (if desired) their specific permissions. Specific permissions must be specified in square brackets immediately after the Steam64 ID (no spaces), such as: 3456789098765432[SetGodMode,RestartServer]
List of [Steam64 IDs](https://steamid.io/) for users who will be allowed to change server settings in-game
If set, BattlEye anti-cheat will be disabled on the server
Specifies additional command line arguments (anything that begins with a - ) that are not otherwise set by AMP. Use with care
Sets the server playstyle tag displayed in the browser (PVE or PVP)
Allows players to switch to first-person camera perspective
Allows players to switch to third-person camera perspective
Enables the on-screen aiming reticle/crosshair for players
Allows players to open the in-game map screen

Hides player kill feed notifications from chat/HUD
Enables the unconscious/coma state when a player takes critical damage
Allows players to craft, place, and trigger landmines and traps
